verdicts.reason: A: the headline lockup sits roughly centred with dot clusters anchoring the bottom corners, so the canvas has some balance. Still, the thin photo strip is stranded at the top with dots overprinting it, large empty bands surround the small title, the right dot cluster is cut off at the edge, and the lockup sits left of centre. B: everything is crammed into the top half (photo strip, headline, dots) and the bottom ~45% is dead navy, so the layout is badly lopsided. The headline is jammed under the strip, and the clipped dot clusters float in the middle with no purpose.
